select r.id, r.code_num as code, r.name, r.app_id, r.description, r.status, r.sort_num, r.created_time, r.updated_time from rm_role_t r where r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and r.deleted = 0
and r.code_num like concat('%', #{code}, '%')
and r.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
order by r.sort_num, r.created_time desc

select o.id, o.serial_number as code, o.name, o.parent_id, o.status, o.sort_num, o.create_time as created_time, o.update_time as updated_time from rm_org_t o where o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and o.deleted = 0
and o.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
order by o.sort_num, o.create_time
